'''Ravilan's aide''', who was referred to as being "'''Yilanna'''" or "'''Illyana'''" by [[Seelah Korsin]], was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] who served as an aide for the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Red Sith]] [[Ravilan Wroth]] around the year [[4985 BBY]].

==Biography==
Ravilan's aide was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]],<ref name="LTotS:Pa" /> who had lived in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and was assigned to the ship ''[[Omen]]'' on a mission to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Lignan]] ore for the upcoming [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Kirrek]] around the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. ''Omen'' had a collision going into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with its sister ship [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] after a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|starfighter]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attacked]] the ships and forced ''Omen'' into a retreat to protect the Lignan they had mined. Like the rest of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], she had crash&ndash;landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] aboard the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith dreadnaught|dreadnaught]] ''Omen'',<ref name="LTotS:Pr">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> and become regarded as one of the [[Deity/Legends|god–like]] [[Skyborn]] of the [[Keshiri/Legends|native's]] legends.<ref name="LTotS:S">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref>

Being in her forties after [[4985 BBY|fifteen years]] on Kesh, she had been assigned to go with the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Red Sith]] [[Ravilan Wroth]] to the village of [[Tetsubal]] on the [[Ragnos Lakes]] to investigate a fluorescent algae for use in lighting Sith structures. Ravilan and his followers, known as the Fifty&ndash;seven, secretly and purposefully caused a plague there by adding the toxic [[cyanogen silicate]] to the [[Water/Legends|water]] in an attempt to scare the Sith on Kesh into focusing their efforts on leaving the planet. Ravilan's aide was killed by the substance, along with approximately eighteen&ndash;thousand Keshiri natives. When her body was found by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who came to investigate the crisis, [[Seelah Korsin]]&mdash;the wife of the leader and [[Grand Lord]] [[Yaru Korsin]]&mdash;identified the swollen, blue features of her tongue as a result of the cyanogen silicate. This led to Seelah deducing Ravilan's involvement in the event, and eventually the [[Red Sith Purge|order]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] all the Red Sith on Kesh by the Grand Lord&mdash;including Ravilan.<ref name="LTotS:Pa" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ravilan's aide was only introduced as the Human Sith aide for the Red Sith Ravilan in the [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]'' by [[John Jackson Miller]], where she only appeared in her dead form after being killed by cyanogen silicate.<ref name="LTotS:Pa" />
